# New SMS Rates from December 1, 2025

Published: 21 november 2025

#### Dear Customers,

We would like to inform you that starting December 1, 2025, mobile network operators in Ukraine will increase the cost of sending SMS messages.

As a result, we are also required to update our pricing policy to reflect the new market conditions and maintain the consistent quality of our service.

💡 Please note that under the new prices, the cost of 1 transactional Viber message is almost 2.5 times cheaper than an SMS. 🧑‍💻 Contact our manager to activate your Viber business account and save your messaging budget!

We appreciate your trust and thank you for your understanding and cooperation!

#### * New SMS rates from 01.12.2025 (Viber rates remain unchanged)

The price of messages includes VAT and depends on the top-up step. The higher the payment amount when topping up your account, the cheaper the message costs.

Top-up step 1

from 1 to 999 UAH.

Top-up step 2

from 1,000 to 9,999 UAH.

Top-up step 3

from 10,000 UAH.

| Ukraine |
| --- |
| SMS | 0.98 1.29 UAH | 0.96 1.28 UAH | 0.94 1.26 UAH |
| Viber (Transactional) | 0.63 UAH | 0.60 UAH | 0.55 UAH |
| Viber (Promotional) | 1.48 UAH | 1.45 UAH | 1.40 UAH |
| Viber (Chat-session) | 1.03 UAH | 1.00 UAH | 0.95 UAH |
